meta.source: Reserve Bank of India (via the Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Policy rates and auction results are final when announced. The Handbook restates a few effective dates between editions (newest edition wins, differences listed in rates-policy meta). Lending and deposit rates: each monthly release repeats the full history; the newest release wins.
meta.coverage: Every auction of central government bonds since April 1995: how much was offered, how much was bid, what the market would not take (devolvement), and the yield the government accepted
meta.note: RBI, Details of Central Government Market Borrowings (DBIE report 559; also 576, 830, 1218), ACTUALS rows, summed over the securities auctioned each day; amounts converted from rupees to ₹ crore. Weighted averages weight each security by its notified amount. Notified totals agree with the RBI's auction press releases (Data Bank rbi_gsec_auctions) on 332 of 349 common days.
